description: This file defines a composable hook 'useUpgrader' for managing software upgrade processes, including version retrieval, migration, and pre-migration checks, using an API service.

methods.name: getVersionList
methods.description: Fetches a list of available versions, optionally excluding the latest.

methods.name: createConfigFiles
methods.description: Creates configuration files needed for upgrade.

methods.name: migrateToVersion
methods.description: Performs migration from a specified version to another.

methods.name: versionGenerator
methods.description: Generator function yielding subsequent versions for migration.
